verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Increase capability for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The closest items are adjacent features: optional approval holds on individual transfers, which review a one-off action rather than an automation definition, and Entity validations per data version, which concern compliance data rather than automations. Neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
